title: It's Always Love That Saves the World
overview: Leon's hopes for a peaceful life are shattered when he's appointed to be one of the Saint's guards.

title: Do You Enjoy the Aesthetics of Destruction?
overview: Leon and his companions head to an elf island in search of treasure.

title: Hey, Brat
overview: The expedition is successful, but Leon's problems begin before he can even make it back to the academy.

title: They're Flip-Flopping Again?
overview: Leon is arrested for treason, and Marquis Frampton and the duchy appear to be conspiring together.

title: I Love Facades
overview: Julius and the idiots attempt to rescue Leon, and Marie crumbles on the front line.

title: If I Don't Like It, I'll Just Run
overview: Leon says he can defeat the invaders, but only if he's made supreme commander.

title: Shut Your Filthy Mouth, Scum
overview: Leon and Marie realize they know each other from their past lives, and Leon confronts Marquis Frampton.

title: You Can't Quantify Love!
overview: Marie and the idiots are recruited to activate the royal ship, and Leon prepares for war.

title: Livia...
overview: Leon's forces engage the guardians of the sky and sea.
